answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 45 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in vine, verified in whisper, and ledge names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 8 hours of verification and 24 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
